meta.descriptor_vector_note: Archive feature descriptor vectors [mean R, mean G, mean B, luminance std, edge density, bright fraction] are REPRESENTATIVE descriptors estimated from the published tone descriptions in the PDFs (e.g. 'light-toned', 'dark olivine-rich basalt'). They are NOT measured from images and NOT published values. They exist only so cosine similarity can be computed in a shared space with uploaded images. Every match is labelled 'model output' and is a similarity score, not a geological claim.
meta.name: Jezero Crater seed archive (Research Lab)
meta.novelty_population: Jezero zones reference population, n = 6 (zones Z1-Z6). Small population, say so.
meta.source_file: jezeroVerified.ts (Mars_Maps repo, machine-readable seed of the two Jezero PDFs: 28-page Research Data Pack + 14-page Values Tables T1-T13)
meta.source_note: Every value below was transcribed from jezeroVerified.ts. Where the TS and the PDFs disagree, the PDFs win; only the TS was on disk in this sandbox, so no PDF cross-check was possible here (see docs/VERIFICATION_LOG.md). Values labelled Supplement are mission-team papers analysing NASA data, never silently merged into NASA. Values labelled Computed are arithmetic on the values above them, not new measurements.

not_published: H2O wt% in Jezero rock (single number) - use T5 H2O 210 ppm in air, T10 hydration 92% of points, carbonate % by zone.
Exact % of clay, silica or hematite per zone - presence/absence only; use T8/T10 mineral % where they exist.
Chemical formulas for vivianite and greigite - NASA names the minerals but does not print formulas.
Age of each of the 3 Margin Unit water events - sequence known, ages NOT determined.
Life on Mars yes/no - Sapphire Canyon is POTENTIAL biosignature only.
Published lat/lon for Bright Angel, Cheyava Falls and Broom Point in the PDFs used here - place by zone + sol, never invent a coordinate.
